title: Jev
description: Optional judgement: record voters, pair relations, duplicate proposals and explicitly granted bounded review-Run assistance. No store, panel, record writer or operator authority. Ready service metadata does not prove credit; refused invocation is no judgment and ordinary review is unchanged. Cached readings may advise review selection. Jev cannot rule, apply links, change feed rank, withhold work or launch sessions.

atyrode.babel.reason: every candidate, immutable revision and provenance is read through Babel's doors; suggestions return to the caller and Jev writes nothing
